build_cached_file: download and cache a single file from a Hugging Face Hub repo or local folder
create_cached_files: locate and download multiple model files from a Hugging Face Hub repo with caching
test_has_file: check if a file exists in a Hugging Face Hub repo without downloading it
review_push_to_hub: push a trained model or tokenizer to the Hugging Face Hub with automatic model card creation
summarize_get_checkpoint_shard_files: download and cache all shards of a sharded model checkpoint from the Hub
